import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    i,o=G[n+' input'],G[n+' output']
    dd=[(r,c,i[r][c],o[r][c]) for r in range(len(i)) for c in range(len(i[0])) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]]
    print(n,'ndiff',len(dd),dd[:8])
ti=G['Test input']
print([(r,c,ti[r][c]) for r in range(len(ti)) for c in range(len(ti[0])) if ti[r][c]==1 or ti[r][c]==7 or ti[r][c]==4][:6])

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        if v!=2: continue
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==k]
        # diagonal-adjacent pair only
        p1,p2=min(pts,key=lambda p:(min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1])) for q in pts))
        q=[p for p in pts if p!=p1]
        if len(q)!=1: continue
        rr,cc=q[0]
        dr=1 if rr>p1[0] else -1
        dc=1 if cc>p1[1] else -1
        # choose direction with longer clear run from that start cell
        def run_len(start,d):
            n=0; p=start
            while True:
                nxt=(p[0]+d[0],p[1]+d[1])
                if not(0<=nxt[0]<H and 0<=nxt[1]<W) or g[nxt[0]][nxt[1]]!=bg: break
                n+=1; p=nxt
            return n
        L1=run_len(p1,(dr,dc)); L2=run_len(p2,(-dr,-dc))
        s = (dr,dc) if L1>=L2 else (-dr,-dc)
        p=p1 if L1>=L2 else p2
        while True:
            q=(p[0]+s[0],p[1]+s[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: break
            res[q[0]][q[1]]=k; p=q
    return res
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(n, solve(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])
print('TEST:', json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); mc=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        if v<2: continue
        ps=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==k]
        mrs=sum(p[0] for p in ps)/len(ps); mcs=sum(p[1] for p in ps)/len(ps)
        rs={r for r,_ in ps}; cs={c for _,c in ps}
        axis='v' if len(rs)<len(cs) else 'h'
        dr = 1 if mrs>mr else -1
        dc = 1 if mcs>mc else -1
        # extend line from pair outward away from centroid along axis, painting bg cells until grid edge
        # determine far end of the pair (cell farther from centroid) as ray start
        def dist(p): 
            d=(p[0]-mrs)**2+(p[1]-mcs)**2
            return d
        start=max((p for p in ps),key=dist)
        def walk(p,axis,s):
            while True:
                if axis=='v': q=(p[0]+s,p[1])
                else: q=(p[0],p[1]+s)
                if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: return
                res[q[0]][q[1]]=k; p=q
        walk(start,'v',dr)
    return res
for n in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    print(n, solve(G[n+' input'])==G[n+' output'])

import itertools, math
def ray_solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        if v!=2: continue
        ps=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==k]
        p1=min(ps,key=lambda p:p[0])
        p2=max(ps,key=lambda p:p[0])
        # direction from p1 to p2 (unit steps along the slope line; diagonal or vertical/horizontal)
        dr=(p2[0]-p1[0]); dc=(p2[1]-p1[1])
        gg=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); dn=(dr//gg,dc//gg)
        def run(start,s):
            n=0;p=start
            while True:
                q=(p[0]+s*dn[0],p[1]+s*dn[1])
                if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: return n
                n+=1;p=q
        L1=run(p1,1); L2=run(p2,-1)
        s = 1 if L1>=L2 else -1
        start = p1 if L1>=L2 else p2
        while True:
            q=(start[0]+s*dn[0],start[1]+s*dn[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: break
            res[q[0]][q[1]]=k; start=q
    return res
for n in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    i,o=G[n+' input'],G[n+' output']
    print(n, ray_solve(i)==o)

def ray_solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        if v!=2: continue
        ps=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==k]
        p1,p2=sorted(ps)  # top-left to bottom-right of the 2x2 diagonal pair? sorted by (r,c) gives TL, BR on a down-right diagonal... 
        # direction from upper cell to lower cell
        dr=(p2[0]-p1[0]); dc=(p2[1]-p1[1])
        gg=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); d=(dr//gg,dc//gg)
        def run(start,s):
            n=0;p=start
            while True:
                q=(p[0]+s*d[0],p[1]+s*d[1])
                if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: return n
                n+=1;p=q
        L1=run(p1,1); L2=run(p2,-1)
        start=p1 if L1>=L2 else p2; s=1 if L1>=L2 else -1
        while True:
            q=(start[0]+s*d[0],start[1]+s*d[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: break
            res[q[0]][q[1]]=k; start=q
    return res

def solve(g,diag_only=False,axis='both'):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    mr=sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts); mc=sum(p[1] for p in pts)/len(pts)
    res=[row[:] for row in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    for k,v in cnt.items():
        if v<2: continue
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==k]
        # determine line direction
        rs={r for r,_ in cells}; cs={c for _,c in cells}
        if len(rs)==1 and len(cs)>=1: axis='v'
        elif len(cs)==1 and len(rs)>=1: axis='h'
        else: axis='d'
        if diag_only and axis!='d': continue
        def dist(p): return (p[0]-mr)**2+(p[1]-mc)**2
        ds=sorted(set([(a[0],a[1]) for a,b in zip(cells,cells[1:])]),key=lambda p:dist(p))
        if axis=='d' and len(ds)!=2: continue
        e1,e2=ds[0],ds[-1]
        d=(e2[0]-e1[0],e2[1]-e1[1]); gg=math.gcd(abs(d[0]),abs(d[1])); d=(d[0]//gg,d[1]//gg)
        L1=run_len_pair(e1,d,-1); L2=run_len_pair(e2,d,1)
        start = e1 if L1>=L2 else e2; s = 1 if L1>=L2 else -1
        while True:
            q=(start[0]+s*d[0],start[1]+s*d[1])
            if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: break
            res[q[0]][q[1]]=k; start=q
    return res
def run_len_pair(start,d,s):
    n=0;p=start
    while True:
        q=(p[0]+s*d[0],p[1]+s*d[1])
        if not(0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W) or g[q[0]][q[1]]!=bg: return n;p=q
